function.description: Price a SWAP before committing to one: the route the swap verb would take (Uniswap V3, then a DEX aggregator if the operator enabled one), the output, the spender approve_token must authorise and an independent-price cross-check. Read-only — moves no funds. Each side is a CONTRACT ADDRESS or 'native' (priced via the wrapped native). EVM chains only: quote Solana with defi_trade.solana_swap(dry_run=true).
function.name: defi_data_swap_quote

amount_in.description: Human amount of token_in to sell

chain.description: Chain to quote on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.

token_in.description: CONTRACT ADDRESS of the token to sell (0x…), or the literal 'native' (quoted via the chain's wrapped-native, as the swap verb prefers)

token_out.description: CONTRACT ADDRESS of the token to buy (0x…), or the literal 'native'
